title: Bulgur, Chickpea and Cauliflower Stew
subtitle: Zahra's menazelet with tomato paste and dried mint
description: A tomato-based stew of fried cauliflower, coarse bulgur and chickpeas, finished with butter sizzled with dried mint. Cook it briefly for a saucy dish or longer for a thicker one.

steps.text: Break the cauliflower into florets and deep fry until golden.

Heat olive oil in a pot and fry the chopped onion until golden. Add the garlic and fry for half a minute. Add the tomato paste and bulgur and fry for about 1 minute. Add the water and bring to the boil (add a little more water if it gets too thick).
Add the chickpeas and cauliflower, cover, reduce the heat and cook for about half an hour.
Pour the stew onto a serving plate. Melt the butter in a frying pan, add the dried mint, fry for about 10 seconds and pour over the stew.
